name: Murls Discounts – Flexible Discounts for WooCommerce
author: Ahsan Haroon

sections.description:
Murls Discounts allows WooCommerce store owners to automatically apply discounts when customers select specific payment methods at checkout.

The plugin supports both percentage-based and fixed amount discounts and integrates seamlessly with both Classic Checkout and the modern Block Checkout experience. Discounts are applied dynamically, without coupons, providing a clean and professional checkout flow.

Murls Discounts is built with a scalable architecture, allowing future expansion to support additional discount rules and conditions.

Features

  • Apply percentage discounts per payment gateway
  • Apply fixed amount discounts per payment gateway
  • Set custom discount labels per gateway
  • Supports Classic Checkout and Block Checkout
  • Works with WooCommerce tax settings
  • Discounts update dynamically when payment method changes
  • Clean admin interface under WooCommerce menu
  • Translation-ready and PHPCS/WPCS compliant
sections.installation:
1. Upload the murls-discounts folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Murls Discounts
  4. Configure discount percentages and fixed amounts per payment gateway
sections.faq:
Can I set different discounts for multiple gateways?

Yes. Each payment gateway can have its own percentage or fixed discount.

Does this work with all payment gateways?

Yes. Any payment gateway registered with WooCommerce is supported.

Does this support WooCommerce Block Checkout?

Yes. Murls Discounts works with both Classic Checkout and Block Checkout.

How are taxes handled?

The discount is applied to the cart subtotal. Taxes are calculated by WooCommerce according to your store configuration. Depending on tax settings and rounding, totals may vary slightly.
